messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — Hosted API GPU pool 'hosted-prod-gpu-1' at 100% utilization and request queue growing rapidly. autoscaler status: ERROR. Paging oncall.

elaine: Ack. I'm on it. watching queue depth metrics now (prod -> hosted, EU region). Can someone drop the current p95/p99 numbers?

matt: p95 token latency up from 120ms -> 1.8s in last 5m, p99 ~ 8.3s, queue length ~ 22k requests, CPU on GPU nodes ~ 95%.

sara: CPU or GPU? GPUs are fully saturated by small-batch sampling workloads from customer X test traffic spike.

elaine: confirmed GPUs. Autoscaler trying to scale but failing with quota errors in control-plane log. snippet:
```
ERROR autoscaler.scale_up: failed to allocate nodes: quota_exceeded: requested=10, available=3
INFO pool_state: current=48, max_allowed=51
```

liam: We're at region quota. cloud team alerted but ETA unknown. tagging @cloud-ops.

julia-support: Customer p95 for hosted-api /v1/generate increased and we have inbound support tickets about timeouts (T=+6m). Major accounts impacted: alpha-inc, medco.raising severity.

sara: Mitigation idea: pause non-critical batch jobs and evict low-priority queues to free GPUs. Can we identify batch-job owners quickly?

elaine: Running query to list pods with low priority and long-running jobs:
```
kubectl get pods -l app=batch -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running
``` 
I'll start drain on 4 low-priority nodes.

matt: I'll prep a temporary rate-limiter change to drop per-customer concurrency for top 5 noisy keys. Patch in gateway:
```
PATCH /gateway/config
{ "ratelimit": { "alpha-inc": 20, "medco": 30 } }
```

incident-bot: Note: creating incident call bridge #inc-1778888888 at :phone: 177-888-8888. Join if needed.

elaine: Drains started on 4 nodes. Observability: queue dropped from 22k -> 12k after evictions. p95 down to 900ms. But autoscaler still showing quota_exceeded; cannot add more nodes.

matt: Can we route some traffic to the US region cluster as fallback? Model versions are compatible (v2.1 and v2.1-quant). We might need to enable cross-region routing policy.

sara: Cross-region switch would add ~200ms to latency for EU customers but will reduce p99 drastically. Need approval for failover; this is a customer-impact decision.

elaine: @matt you have the oncall next. I'm going to hand off: summary -> GPUs saturated by noisy small-batch workloads, autoscaler blocked by cloud quota, mitigations applied (drain low-priority, per-customer throttle). Queue halved. Opening handoff to Matt now.

matt: Taking over oncall. I'll coordinate with cloud-ops and product to decide cross-region failover. Also enable emergency burst (if allowed) — cloud team, can you confirm if emergency capacity can be granted?

liam: cloud-ops: we're investigating, but quota increase requires ticket. We can temporarily authorize 'burst nodes' up to +5 for 30 minutes via manual override. Applying now.

incident-bot: autoscaler: scale_up succeeded after manual_override. added 5 nodes.

matt: New nodes are joining. queue down to ~3k, p95 ~220ms, p99 ~1.1s. Great. I'll keep monitoring for 20m and prepare a post-incident note.

julia-support: Opened CS communication to alpha-inc and medco to inform them of throttling and mitigations. Keeping them updated.

elaine: thx all. Handing off completely to @matt. My shift ends in 8m. Anything else high priority?

matt: I'll keep this as P1 for now. Plan: 1) stabilize, 2) request formal quota increase, 3) evaluate per-tenant admission controls, 4) run postmortem. Scheduling postmortem tomorrow 10:00am. cc: eng-sre, product.

sara: add note to run retention on kv-cache to prevent long-running small-batch repeats.

matt: Logged incident in tracker INC-2026-1778888888. Closing oncall handoff. Thanks.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P2. Monitoring mode. Metrics dashboard link: https://dash.prod.redwood.ai/d/infra/hosted-queue
